title: Charmed nuclei and exotic charmed meson production at CBM@FAIR and ALICE@LHC
summary: We make predictions for the expected multiplicities of exotic charmed hadrons and charmed nuclei in Au+Au collisions at SIS100 and LHC beam energies, using input on light hadron and charm production from the UrQMD transport model, and applying the Thermal-FIST model. We demonstrate that the CBM experiment has the capability to explore these states with production rates of one per 3 seconds for $χ_{c0}(1P)$ and $χ_{c1}(1P)$, and one every 3 minutes for $X(3872)$ at the expected data taking rates.
